name: Palm Down Hand

contextMeanings.meaning: Dramatizing a low-effort reaction or shrug.

platformNotes.note: Used for drop-coded and adult-coded dismissal tweets. The palm-down hand is the visible 'moving on' default across close-friends replies.
Common in dismiss-coded stories and aesthetic-coded moving-on shares. The palm-down hand reads as the visible drop default on story overlays and reply captions.
Default comment-section reaction to adult-coded low-effort clips. The palm-down hand pairs with visual-cue-coded clip reactions; Gen Z reads it as the universal next-topic default.

generationalNotes.note: May use 🫴 literally for placing or dropping.

seoTitle: 🫴 Palm Down Hand Emoji Meaning - What Does 🫴 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the palm down hand emoji 🫴 really means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 🫴 Palm Down Hand emoji was added in Unicode 14 (2021) and is drawn as a single open hand with the palm facing downward, as if placing or dropping something. The visual cue reads instantly as drop-coded reference, dismissal default, or the visible 'moving on' tag. By 2026 🫴 has become the go-to emoji for the drop-coded reaction, the visible dismissal default, and the low-effort-coded reaction in close-friends and group chats.

In modern chat 🫴 does very specific work. People send it as a literal drop-coded reference, as the visible 'low effort' tag, or as the moving-on-coded default. The open palm facing downward is the visual cue that the read is dropping or moving on. Writers should pick 🫴 when the read is drop/dismiss or visible 'low effort' energy, and avoid it when the read is full-on two palms — 🤲 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
🫴 lands on a friend's low-effort message, in a work channel where someone is signaling drop-coded energy, and in a group chat where the sender is signaling moving on. The open palm facing downward anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 🫴 reads as the universal low-effort default and the visible 'dropping this thread' tag. On X the emoji punctuates dismiss-coded and moving-on tweets. The emoji pairs with 🫱 for the layered palm-down-and-palm-up stack and with 💅 for the layered low-effort-and-shrug stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 🫴 in any context where the read is supposed to be a raised palm. The downward palm implies dropping, not raising. Avoid 🫴 in casual contexts where the dismiss-coded read lands as dismissive.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 🫴 on a drop-coded message, mirror with another 🫴 or 💅 to send matching energy. The drop chain reads as solidarity.

If 🫴 lands as the moving-on default, reply with another 🫴 or 🤷. And if you want to send 🫴 yourself, pair it with the moment so the drop-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 🫴 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 🫴 means drop-coded reference, dismissal energy, or the visible 'moving on' reaction. The open palm facing downward is the visual cue that the read is drop-coded.

faqs.question: Is 🫴 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. 🫴 reads as flirty-coded in a dating thread combined with 'anyway' tag content as playful dismissal-coded tease.

faqs.question: What does 🫴 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 🫴 carries the same drop-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 🫴 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok, 🫴 is the default comment reaction to drop-coded and moving-on clips.
